1. Conda
curl -O https://repo.anaconda.com/miniconda/Miniconda3-latest-Linux-x86_64.sh
bash Miniconda3-latest-Linux-x86_64.sh
source ~/.bashrc

2. gcc
sudo apt install -y build-essential

3. Env
conda create -n llm python=3.10
cd agriculture-llm
pip install -r requirements.txt

conda install pytorch torchvision pytorch-cuda=12.1 -c pytorch -c nvidia -y
pip install -U transformers accelerate safetensors sentencepiece pillow

4. Model-Finetuned
python -m vllm.entrypoints.openai.api_server \
    --model Qwen/Qwen2.5-32B-Instruct \
    --quantization fp8 \
    --enable-lora \
    --lora-modules agri-lora=manhcuong2005/qwen2.5-32b-agri-lora \
    --port 8500 \
    --gpu-memory-utilization 0.5 \
    --max-model-len 8192 \
    --trust-remote-code
5. Vision model

python -m vllm.entrypoints.openai.api_server     --model Qwen/Qwen2.5-VL-7B-Instruct     --trust-remote-code     --gpu-memory-utilization 0.3     --max-model-len 4096     --limit-mm-per-prompt '{"image": 2}'     --port 8080     --host 0.0.0.0
